Dear diary,
If only I was as smart and handsome as the developer of
The Hero's Path...
Apparently rooms with 2 beds have the beds together to
foster "intimacy" among members.\. Whatever that means.
I went to someone's room and saw what looked like a
pile of brown rocks.
But when I touched it,\. it was soft and tasted funny.\.
Took me a while to realize what it was...
Apparently the leader really likes this horse named
"Goldship."\. Is that why his favorite number is 564?
I'm actually really good at sideways writing,\. as you
can see.
As I write,\. we have just received word that we will
be relocating to a new base.
So many cheers erupted.\. Apparently everyone was sick
and tired of this shabby space and wanted something
better.\. Then they started hurling bottles around in
the cafeteria and making a crazy mess.
I don't really care,\. I just hope I still get a room
with two beds beside each other in the next base.
